subject.title: Doubao/BytePlus model catalog: cacheRead/cacheWrite pricing set to 0, missing context caching cost

question: Should this issue be fixed by replacing or retargeting the conflicting fork PR with a current-manifest update, and what vendor-backed cacheRead/cacheWrite mapping should OpenClaw use for BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao?
rationale: The code location is clear, but pricing values and cache storage/write semantics are external billing/product facts that automation should not invent.

options.title: Replace with current-manifest fix
options.body: Open a narrow same-repository fix against extensions/byteplus and extensions/volcengine after confirming the vendor pricing and cacheWrite mapping.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to retarget the open fork PR from deleted src/agents files to the current plugin manifests and expand it to cover both providers.

options.title: Defer for vendor proof
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until someone with current BytePlus/Volcengine billing access confirms the exact rates.

recommendation.title: Replace with current-manifest fix
recommendation.body: Open a narrow same-repository fix against extensions/byteplus and extensions/volcengine after confirming the vendor pricing and cacheWrite mapping.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter carried the provider catalog refactors into the plugin-manifest boundary and is the strongest current history signal for deciding the durable fix shape.
